name: VR Overturn
summary: VR Overturn is a mean reversion EA that identifies overextended market moves and enters trades anticipating a reversal. It uses a combination of volatility-based indicators and price action to detect overturn points where price is likely to snap back. The EA systematically manages entries with defined risk parameters and exits on mean reversion completion or stop loss.
summary_zh: VR Overturn是一个均值回归EA，通过识别市场过度延伸的走势，在预期反转时入场交易。它结合波动率指标和价格行为来检测价格可能回弹的翻转点。该EA采用系统化方式管理入场，并在均值回归完成或止损时出场。
strategy_analysis: VR Overturn策略的核心概念是均值回归，即市场在过度偏离均值后倾向于回归。入场条件基于价格相对于统计均值的偏离程度，当偏离达到预设阈值时触发交易信号，逆势入场。出场条件包括价格回归均值时获利了结，以及设置固定止损来限制单笔亏损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，支持自定义仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA提供止损机制但需要用户合理配置参数以控制整体风险。该策略在震荡市中表现较好，但在强趋势市中可能遭遇连续逆势亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of VR Overturn is mean reversion, based on the principle that markets tend to return to their mean after excessive deviation. Entry conditions rely on measuring price deviation from a statistical mean, triggering trade signals when deviation exceeds a preset threshold, entering against the prevailing move. Exit conditions include taking profit when price reverts to the mean and using fixed stop losses to limit individual trade losses. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing, with customizable lot parameters. Money management incorporates stop loss mechanisms but requires users to configure parameters appropriately to control overall portfolio risk. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses during strong trending conditions.
pros: 均值回归逻辑在震荡市中具有统计优势，长期正期望值
明确的止损设置限制了单笔交易的最大亏损
参数化设计允许用户根据不同品种和市场环境调整策略
逆势入场在价格极端偏离时提供了较好的风险回报比
pros_en: Mean reversion logic provides statistical edge in ranging markets with positive expectancy over time
Defined stop loss limits maximum loss per trade, providing clear risk boundaries
Parameterized design allows users to adapt the strategy for different instruments and market conditions
Counter-trend entry at extreme price deviations offers favorable risk-reward ratios
cons: 在强趋势市场中逆势交易可能导致连续止损，造成较大回撤
均值回归策略对市场regime切换敏感，缺乏自适应机制
未明确包含加仓或仓位调整逻辑，无法在亏损时优化持仓
波动率剧变时止损可能被频繁触发
cons_en: Counter-trend trading in strong trending markets can lead to consecutive stop losses and significant drawdown
Mean reversion strategy is sensitive to market regime changes and lacks adaptive mechanisms
No explicit position scaling or adjustment logic, limiting ability to optimize holdings during losing streaks
Stop losses may be frequently triggered during volatility spikes
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器，在强趋势市场中暂停逆势交易或减少仓位
引入动态止损止盈，根据当前波动率自动调整风险参数
添加市场状态识别模块，自动切换震荡和趋势模式
improvements_en: Add a trend filter to pause counter-trend trading or reduce position size during strong trending markets
Introduce dynamic stop loss and take profit based on current volatility (ATR-based) for adaptive risk management
Add a market regime detection module to automatically switch between ranging and trending modes

risk_points: 逆势交易在趋势行情中面临连续亏损风险
固定止损可能无法适应不同波动率环境
缺乏最大回撤或最大连亏次数限制
risk_points_en: Counter-trend trading faces consecutive loss risk during trending markets
Fixed stop loss may not adapt to varying volatility environments
No maximum drawdown or maximum consecutive loss limits implemented

The EA systematically manages entries with defined risk parameters and exits on mean reversion completion or stop loss.
